result:
Posts can now be scheduled to publish later. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (9 tests, 7 of them new) and `bunx guren gate` all pass. I also ran `bun run console posts:scheduled` against the test database, and it printed only the tab-separated lines, soonest first.

- **Storage:** `posts` has a new nullable text column, `published_at`, added in `db/schema.ts` with a generated migration under `db/migrations/20260925040115_add_published_at_to_posts/`. It holds ISO 8601 UTC like `created_at`. Whether a post is public is decided when each request runs, by comparing that text with the current time, so nothing has to run when a post goes live.
- **Form field:** the create and edit requests accept an optional `publishAt` (checked in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`). Absent or `null` means publish now. A value like `next tuesday` gets the same 422 as an empty title, and nothing is saved. On edit, leaving `publishAt` out also clears the date, because the contract says absent means "publish now".
- **Who sees what:** the list, search and the post page (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`) all go through two new helpers on `app/Models/Post.ts`. A scheduled post shows only for its author, and its page is a 404 for everyone else, the same response as a post that doesn't exist. Each post now carries `publishedAt` for the author.
- **Forms and pages:** the create and edit forms have a new "Publish at" field (`resources/js/components/PublishAtField.tsx`). It converts the browser's local time to UTC before sending. The list and post page show a "Scheduled" note with the go-live time.
- **Report:** `bun run console posts:scheduled` prints `<id>\t<title>\t<published_at>` for each scheduled post, soonest first. It prints nothing when nothing is scheduled and exits 0. The command is in `app/Console/Commands/ListScheduledPostsCommand.ts`.
- **Change to shared startup code:** on a database with migrations still to apply, the app's "Applied N migration(s)" message was landing on stdout ahead of the report. I changed `bin/console.ts` so messages logged while the app starts up go to stderr. This applies to every console command, not just the report.

The new tests are in `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts`.

In summary: I added a nullable `published_at` column (schema plus migration) and an optional `publishAt` field on the create and edit requests, stored as UTC ISO text. Visibility helpers on `app/Models/Post.ts` hide scheduled posts from everyone but their author in the list, search and post page, which is a 404 for others. The create and edit forms have a "Publish at" field, and the list and post pages show a scheduled note. The `posts:scheduled` command prints tab-separated lines, soonest first, and startup logging in `bin/console.ts` now goes to stderr so its stdout stays clean. Tests are in `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts`.
